title: Keto Pizza Casserole (Crustless Pizza)
conventions: buy strings are cook measures (what goes in the pot), grams derived FROM the printed measure via db\densities.json (or the flagged label/USDA unit weights where densities has no row) so the two agree by construction; quantities quantized to house quarters, drift from the exact 1.1667x scale noted per line where it exceeds 5%.
ruled_substitutions: 'Tomato Basil Sauce' books to the house Marinara Sauce item and its GV label row: tomato-basil is a flavor variant inside the one jarred pasta-sauce class (marinara IS a tomato-basil-garlic sauce), same product concept at the same price class - a brand/flavor ruling like the Rao's-to-house-marinara precedent, not a food swap. Macro spread across marinara-class labels is ~10 cal/half-cup.

'Pizza Blend Cheese' books to the house Mozzarella Cheese DB row (USDA low-moisture part-skim shredded) against the shredded-cheese board commodity: retail pizza blend is predominantly low-moisture mozzarella (plus provolone/cheddar), shared record disclosed not averaged (guajillo precedent), and the shredded-cheese commodity's own include puts mozzarella-class shreds in one price class (monterey-jack precedent).

macro_cross_check.verdict: Protein PASS dead-on (+0.2%) - portions are right; the main protein and pepperoni are explicit source weights, no each-weight assumptions anywhere. The -10.3% calorie gap traces to ONE row, and it is the same row italian-sausage-peppers-onions-skillet flagged: the house Hot Italian Sausage entry (Johnsonville, 190 cal per 70 g = 2.71 cal/g) applied to raw pounds. If that 70 g serving is a COOKED-link basis (USDA raw pork Italian sausage runs 3.46 cal/g; the row's own note says it replaced a figure matching Johnsonville's cooked-link panel), the honest raw compute is 445.4 cal/serving and the recipe passes comfortably - which is also what the source's own 436 implies their calculator booked. NOT resolved here: the row carries a deliberate house correction note and overriding it would be a guess. Same disposition as the sibling: flagged for the batch auditor / meal-macro label verification before any band ruling.
macro_cross_check.band_check: computed 391.0 cal FAILS the [400, 650] floor by 9 cal on the current Hot Italian Sausage row; on the USDA raw-basis reading it computes 445.4 and PASSES. Optional mushrooms add +4.0 cal/serving (395.0 / 449.4). Carbs 8.9 g <= 35 PASS (9.7 with mushrooms). Do not adjust numbers to fit - resolve the sausage row's raw/cooked basis first; this is now the SECOND recipe in this run whose band verdict hangs on that one row.

loud_flags: Band verdict is hostage to the Hot Italian Sausage DB row's unresolved raw-vs-cooked serving basis (391 FAIL vs 445 PASS) - second occurrence in this run after italian-sausage-peppers-onions-skillet; the physical Johnsonville label (meal-macro skill) settles both recipes at once and should be treated as this batch's highest-value label errand.

Term resolver misfire: 'pizza blend cheese' answers via the frozen-pizza commodity (include /\bpizza\b/) - a bag of shredded cheese priced as a frozen pizza. Bid routed to shredded-cheese instead.

ingredient-map's 'Mozzarella Cheese' -> mozzarella-cheese entry points at an id that exists in NEITHER commodities.json nor recipe-commodities.json (stale feed id, same defect class as the frozen-broccoli-florets entry keto-turkey-broccoli flagged); stamp-time the map would override this file's shredded-cheese bid with a dead id - needs a map correction before this recipe's stamp pass.
